name: AumNexCart
author: AumCreate

sections.description:
AumNexCart provides a clean product catalog system for WordPress sites that need to showcase products with rich media, dynamic specifications, and contact actions instead of a shopping cart. It is part of the AumViso GEO suite by AumCreate.

Features:

  • Custom post type for products with hierarchical categories
  • Multi-image and video gallery per product (local uploads + remote URLs)
  • Three price modes: range, custom text, hidden
  • Dynamic key-value attributes per product
  • Contact actions (email / WhatsApp / custom URL) replace “Add to Cart”
  • Theme-overridable templates
  • Theme-aware CSS that adapts to host theme variables
  • Frontend filter bar with category / attribute / price filters
  • URL or AJAX filter modes
  • CSV import / export for bulk product management
  • Duplicate product action
  • Rebuild attribute filter index after configuration changes
  • One-click WooCommerce migration when ready to enable online sales
  • WPML and Polylang compatibility

More from AumCreate

sections.installation:
1. Upload the aumnexcart folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress
  3. Visit Settings > Permalinks and save (to refresh rewrite rules)
  4. Visit AumNexCart > Add New to create your first product
  5. Configure AumNexCart > Settings to your liking (or, when the AumCreate theme is active, under the AumCreate menu)
sections.changelog:
The full history, including older releases, is in changelog.txt inside the plugin folder.

1.4.5

  • Changed: the catalogue export and import call fputcsv() and fgetcsv() with an explicit
    $escape argument of ''. The default changes in PHP 8.4, and an empty string is the
    behaviour described by RFC 4180 — the one spreadsheet software produces and expects. Files
    written by earlier versions that contain a backslash immediately before a quotation mark will
    read that backslash as part of the field rather than as an escape. Files from Excel, Numbers
    and Google Sheets are unaffected.
  • Removed: the bundled Simplified Chinese translation, languages/aumnexcart-zh_CN.po and
    aumnexcart-zh_CN.mo. Translations for plugins hosted on WordPress.org are served as
    language packs built from translate.wordpress.org, not shipped inside the plugin. No
    language pack exists for this plugin yet, so after updating, a site running in Simplified
    Chinese will show the English strings until one is approved and published.

1.4.4

  • Added: a “Manual” link next to Deactivate on the Plugins screen, pointing at the manual in the
    administrator’s own language (English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese).
    Until now the plugin shipped only inside a template kit, where the manual arrived through that
    channel; installed from the directory there was nothing in the admin saying where to find it.
  • Changed: the changelog in this file now carries only recent releases. wordpress.org truncates
    that section at 5000 bytes without saying so, and the full history is longer. All of it is kept
    in changelog.txt inside the plugin folder.

1.4.3

  • Fixed: on the settings screen, the Product and Category URL slug fields could run past the
    right edge of their card at browser widths just above 782 pixels. The fields carry core’s
    regular-text class, which sets a fixed width and no maximum; core only clamps it below that
    breakpoint. They now fill their column instead.

1.4.2

  • Every name the plugin declares is now prefixed aumnexcart. WordPress.org requires a prefix of
    at least four characters and its analyser reads the token before the first underscore, so the
    previous aum_ counted as three:

    post type aum_nexcart_product -> aumnexcart_product
    taxonomy aum_nexcart_category -> aumnexcart_category
    options aum_nexcart_settings -> aumnexcart_settings (and two more)
    post meta _aum_nexcart_price_min -> _aumnexcart_price_min (and eight more)
    shortcodes [aum_nexcart_enquiry] -> [aumnexcart_enquiry] (and one more)
    URL parameters ?aum_enquiry_add= -> ?aumnexcart_enquiry_add= (and two more)
    classes AUM_NexCart_Product -> AumNexCart_Product (eighteen)
    constants AUM_NEXCART_PATH -> AUMNEXCART_PATH (four)
    hooks aum_nexcart_card_after_title -> aumnexcart_card_after_title (nine)
    REST namespace aum-nexcart/v1 -> aumnexcart/v1

    This is a breaking change for stored data and for links or shortcodes written by hand. No
    migration routine is included: the plugin has not been distributed, so products and settings
    saved by a pre-release build must be re-created. Each name is now defined once, as a class
    constant.

  • CSV import filters the imported file’s own HTML. wp_insert_post() applies kses only for users
    without the unfiltered_html capability, which a single-site administrator has, so markup in an
    imported CSV reached post_content unfiltered and was rendered by the_content. The person
    running an import is not the author of the file being imported. Descriptions now pass through
    wp_kses_post() and titles through sanitize_text_field(): script, style and event-handler
    attributes are removed, while paragraphs, emphasis, links, lists, images, shortcodes and
    non-Latin text are unchanged apart from a bare & being encoded as &.
  • The Enquiry settings page no longer writes a shortcode or URL parameter name inside a
    translatable sentence; both arrive as placeholders taken from the constants. A name inside a
    translatable string turns its existing translations into fuzzy entries when it changes, and
    fuzzy entries are excluded from the compiled catalogue, so the sentence silently falls back to
    English. zh_CN covers 207 of 207 strings with no fuzzy entries.
  • The settings hint and three code comments still used Aumframe’s old shortcode name
    ([aum_form] -> [aumframe_form], renamed in Aumframe 1.31.0 for the same reason). They now
    name the current one.
  • CSS class names (.aum-nexcart-*) are unchanged. They are not in the PHP or JavaScript global
    namespace and nothing outside the plugin references them.
